title: Smart links
subtitle: Short links (/s/...) for campaigns, events and sharing; change where they point at any time.
empty_body: Create short links to a profile, a vCard download or any web address.
slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and . _ - / between them. Changing it later breaks the old address.
delete_body: Delete {{path}}? Printed material and shares using this address stop working.
target_hint.social_hub: Opens the profile page with only its social links.
presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.subtitle: How the page looks when it is opened through this link. The profile's own page does not change.
presentation.theme_hint: "Profile's theme" keeps the look set on the profile's public page.
presentation.modules_hint: Off: the sections the profile shows. A link can only hide sections, never show ones the profile hides.
presentation.primary_action_hint: If the profile has no matching contact, the button saves the contact instead.
presentation.lead_capture_hint: Visitors who open the profile through this link can leave their contact details.
presentation.lead_capture_needs_profile: The lead form only appears when the target is the profile page.
presentation.passcode_hint: Visitors enter the passcode before the link opens.
presentation.passcode_keep: Leave empty to keep the current passcode
error.passcode_short: Enter a passcode of at least {{min}} characters.
